title: Chapter 774
text:
The headquarters of the Black Star Corps became lively.

In the half a month after the recruitment order was issued, countless spaceships visited the headquarters of the Black Star Corps every day. They were all new members selected by Philip and the Department of Affairs. They came to the headquarters to meet with Black Star and wait for the inspection of the Army Commander.

Before the fleet that went to the battle had even returned to the headquarters, all the new members had already formed a long line outside the satellite base, waiting for the return of Black Star. Looking up from the surface of Planet Golden Gate, the headquarters of the Black Star Corps that covered the sky seemed to have an additional ring formed by spaceships. The light was like a fog, like a ribbon.

"Another large batch of new members has arrived." In a metal base on the surface of the headquarters, the instructor Brock, who was supervising the training of the reserve members, looked out of the porthole and could not help but sigh.

It had been more than ten years since Brock joined the Black Star Corps. He had personally witnessed the history of the Black Star Corps, how it had grown from an ordinary mercenary group to a behemoth that had allied with a Universal Civilization.

Dark-star had long been destroyed, and the discrimination problem of Godora had basically been solved. Now, the Godora hybrids who were wandering around gradually returned to the embrace of the Godora Civilization. Without a goal to strive for, Brock buried his past and decided to hide his past as a Dark-star spy forever. He put away all his thoughts and completely submitted to the Black Star Corps.

However, what Brock did not know was that Han Xiao had always known about his identity. It was just that Dark-star had already been destroyed, and Han Xiao was not prepared to deal with this obedient spy, keeping him to work.

Although the work in the army was tough, after giving up his identity as a Dark-star, Brock's mentality became very relaxed. He gradually fell in love with the process of nurturing batch after batch of army warriors. Under Han Xiao's care, he had been an instructor for ten years. He was used to this responsibility and was getting more and more used to it.

Now, he was a veteran in the army, and he was also the number one figure in the Godora Faction. Due to the reputation of the Black Star Corps in Godora, many Godora people worked in the army and formed the Godora Faction. This was one of the many factions in the army, and with the current scale of the Black Star Corps, there were naturally many factions within the army.

When he looked up to observe the spaceships in the sky, among the large group of spaceships in orbit around the satellite, there were three passengers on one of the spaceships staring at the Black Star Corps headquarters.

It was a small, standard spaceship of the most common model in space, which was rather inconspicuous.

"Can we really sneak in? The Black Star Corps won't be careless, right?"

A man with thick eyebrows and big eyes said hesitantly. He was a certain humanoid species with smooth, shiny silver skin that had a metallic texture. He wore a dark black cloak, and the exposed skin was covered with complicated and exquisite magic patterns.

"There's no other way. If we want to see that person, we can only sneak into the Black Star Corps headquarters," another person said. Another person spoke. This was a mixed-blood human with bright red dragon scales on both sides of his cheeks. He was tall and sturdy, about four meters tall. He wore a simple metal vest, revealing his muscular arms. He looked extraordinarily valiant.

"Don't worry. Even if we're discovered, we can pretend to be people who want to try our luck to join the Black Star Corps. They'll at most chase us away in public. There won't be any danger."

The last person leaned against the wall and spoke lazily. He wore a tight, custom-made combat suit, and two pairs of arms extended from his shoulders. One of his arms was resting behind his head, appearing very relaxed. The other hand was playing with a silver mechanical alloy dagger, and the other two arms were resting on his waist. He gave off a frivolous aura.

These three people were not new members of the Black Star Corps like the others. They had other motives, and the silver-skinned man seemed to be the leader of the three.

Right at this moment, on the other side of the starry sky outside the porthole, streams of hyperdrive light suddenly shot over and stopped above Planet Golden Gate. The Black Star Corps fleet had finally returned to the headquarters.

"Woah, so many new members want to join." Han Xiao's eyes lit up when he saw the spaceships in the headquarters.

"This is only the first batch of new members. They're all waiting for you, Master. Hum." In Han Xiao's field of vision connected to the quantum network, Philip suddenly appeared, and his tiny body appeared in front of Han Xiao's eyes.

"Humph, I suggest that we send out the Mech Legion to test the actual combat strength of these new members. Those who don't meet the requirements don't have the right to join Master!" On the other side, the usually silent combat artificial intelligence Sparda also revealed its virtual body. Its appearance was that of a figure wrapped in heavy mechanical armor, and its face could not be seen clearly. Only a pair of cold eyes could be seen, and its voice was deep and powerful.

Han Xiao's Virtual Technology had long been perfected. He had studied Risda's data structure and imitated it. He had also given his auxiliary artificial intelligence the ability to think and a unique personality to increase its computing ability. His brain was connected to the quantum network, so he could monitor the movements of the auxiliary artificial intelligence at any time. He did not have to worry about any accidents happening, and it was just like raising a pet. Furthermore, not only did it not need anyone to clean up its mess, it would not throw a tantrum, and it could even help him with his chores …

How could there be a more perfect pet in the world?

In the quantum network, Han Xiao's thoughts turned into a torrent of data tentacles, bringing Philip in front of him. "You can open the spaceport of the headquarters now. After my fleet lands, let these new members come and see me."

"Understood, hum …"

The spaceport of the headquarters opened, and the Black Star fleet slowly landed. The many new members who had been waiting for many days finally received the notification that they were allowed to land in the headquarters.

In an instant, the spaceship ring of the headquarters split into more than ten streams that flowed into the various spaceports. The countless mechanical assistants of the headquarters had already been activated to receive all the new members.

Most of the new members were led to the spacious hall of the headquarters. When everyone was present, they would meet Han Xiao together. The new members who had reached the Calamity Grade had special treatment. They would pass through the internal passageway and head to the conference room to meet Han Xiao and the army officers in advance.

Han Xiao brought a group of officers to the conference room. There were more than ten people in the room, and they all turned to look at Han Xiao. All of them stood up.

"Your Excellency Black Star!" "Army Commander!"

They were the first batch of Calamity Grade Supers recruited this time, and they came from different Star Systems. Now that they saw the new Beyond Grade A in person, they were secretly excited.

In the eyes of ordinary people, Calamity Grade Supers were already unreachable figures. However, when facing a Beyond Grade A, most Calamity Grade Supers felt similar to how ordinary people looked at them. Furthermore, there was an additional layer of yearning and desire.

"Hello." Han Xiao smiled.

After becoming a Beyond Grade A, not only had his strength increased, but his horizons had also been raised. If it was in the past, he would definitely have laughed on the spot if more than twenty Calamity Grade Supers joined the army together. However, he was much calmer now. He could wait until there was no one around.

Although the name of a Beyond Grade A had a lot of appeal, Calamity Grade Supers were still high-end combatants. Many Grade A Supers were not willing to join other organizations. Even after becoming a Beyond Grade A, Han Technician did not look down on Calamity Grade Supers. To be able to recruit more than ten high-end combatants at once was the highest record in the history of the Black Star Corps.

Han Xiao chatted with the Calamity Grade Supers one by one and encouraged them. These people were all high-end combatants and would definitely become officers of the army in the future.

The scale of the army was too large, and Han Xiao did not have the time to check the attributes of every new member like before. Thus, he only checked the higher-level newcomers, which were these Calamity Grade Supers.

After quietly checking everyone's attributes, Han Xiao nodded to himself.

Although none of them have a Molding Talent, the strongest one has reached Grade A +. His combat strength is not bad, and he's still a small boss.

Turning around to look at Hella, Han Xiao said, "The Black Star Guards are my elite troops, and Grade A is the entry requirement. Hardaway is also a member of the Black Star Guards. This is the captain of the Black Star Guards, Hella. The Black Star Guards have only been established not long ago and are about to be expanded. She and the other Black Star Guards will test your abilities and select some of you to join the Black Star Guards."

The eyes of the Calamity Grade Supers sparkled. The Black Star Guards were obviously the personal guards of Black Star. To be able to follow around a Beyond Grade A, this position was very tempting to them. Compared to the benefits of ordinary officers, they valued learning from the experience of a Beyond Grade A Super more. After all, at their level, it was too easy to earn money. The attraction of material comforts was limited, and what they pursued was more of a promotion.

The Black Star Guards left with the Calamity Grade Supers. Han Xiao brought the other officers and was about to meet the tens of millions of new army members in the crowded hall. At this moment, Philip suddenly appeared.

"Master, hum … I discovered a spaceship that did not pass the identification test. There are three people on board who were not invited by us. They are not new members of the army, and there is no information about them in the database. Their identities are unknown. They are currently entering the sixth spaceport. Do you want to see their information, hum?"

"Oh, they might be here to fish in troubled waters and try to join the army. Just chase them away …" The images of the three people were transmitted to his mind. Before Han Xiao could finish, he suddenly paused, and his eyes slowly widened.

Seeing that Han Xiao did not respond, Philip tilted his head and called out in confusion, "Master?"

"Hu …"

Han Xiao let out a long sigh. His eyes sparkled, and he said, "Don't stop them. Let them in and pretend that you don't know who they are. Secretly activate all the surveillance cameras in the army and lock onto their movements."

"Okay, hum …"

After leaving the quantum network, Han Xiao rubbed his chin and narrowed his eyes.

"Who would have thought that these three ferocious people would appear in my territory at this time … Hmm, looks like the butterfly effect I've caused is spreading more and more. They're most likely here to find her …"

…

The spaceship entered the orbit and stopped in the warehouse. The silver-skinned man, the dragon-scaled man, and the four-handed man stepped onto the crowded dock and looked around amidst the commotion.

There was no alarm as expected, and no mechanical assistant came to confirm the identities of the three of them. No one came to bother them.

They got in so smoothly?

"The security measures of the Black Star Corps are too crude. It's as good as not having any." The four-handed man curled his lips. "Even my mother planet, which is about to be destroyed by those mad scientists, is safer than this place."

The silver-skinned man was a little nervous, and he said softly, "Let's blend into the crowd first, then find an opportunity to split up. We must not be discovered."

"Hmm." The dragon-scaled man nodded and responded in a low voice.

The silver-skinned man squeezed his fingers and muttered.

"Hopefully, we can find the rumored Rossellin …"

—
